outcome: A slot becomes occupied when its sensor reports a car

requirements.text: When the sensor reports a car, the slot becomes occupied: a free slot, and a reserved one whose booking arrived
A reserved slot whose sensor sees nothing stays reserved
requirements.exclusionReason: this behaviour exists today and has no test; the Goal does not change it

exclusions: Reserved slots with an empty reading: the behaviour exists today and is not changed here

acceptance.text: A free slot becomes occupied when the sensor reports a car
boundaries: a second reading of the same car keeps the slot occupied

acceptance.text: A reserved slot becomes occupied when the booked car arrives
acceptance.given: a slot reserved for a booking

acceptance.text: 1000 sensor readings take less than 50 ms at the 95th percentile
acceptance.given: a lot of 1000 slots, some free and some reserved
acceptance.when: one reading per slot arrives in a burst
acceptance.then: handling the burst takes under 50 ms at the 95th percentile
